01 / Lore

Seen it all.
Felt nothing.

Bored Cat watched every cycle. Every rug. Every thread promising “100x incoming.” He watched charts draw mountains, cliffs, and shapes with names invented by men who needed sleep. Everyone screamed buy. Everyone screamed sell. Bored Cat adjusted one paw and closed his eyes. Not because he is lazy. Not because he is sad. He has simply achieved a level of market detachment normally reserved for furniture. Now he lives on Base, where blocks keep moving whether he cares or not. He does not. That is the point.
